description: Paleography + hsmsLinter structural codes for agent memory.

rules.title: Foliation markers
rules.guidance: Mark each leaf top with [fol. Nr] / [fol. Nv]. Never invent folios not visible in the scan.

rules.title: Column envelopes
rules.guidance: Enclose column text in {CB1. …} or {CB2. …}. All nested environments must close inside the same column block.

rules.title: Drop-cap gutter spacing
rules.guidance: After {INn.} use exactly one ASCII space before the following text.

rules.title: Expansions vs superscripts
rules.guidance: Expanded abbreviations use <…>; raised graphs use <<…>>. Both must be same-line, non-empty, no internal spaces.

rules.title: i vs j
rules.guidance: Use i for non-descending strokes; j when the stroke descends below the baseline.

rules.title: u vs v
rules.guidance: Preserve scribal u/v as written; do not modernize orthography.

rules.title: Tildes and nasals
rules.guidance: Nasal tildes expand as <n>/<m>; use n~ for palatal ñ when the manuscript uses a tilde.

rules.title: Wrap-back %2
rules.guidance: Use %2 when line-end text wraps back to the right margin of the preceding line; space calderones correctly.

rules.title: Marginal glosses
rules.guidance: Right/left glosses use {GLR. […]} / {GLL. […]} with gloss text in brackets when required.

rules.title: Lacunae and illegibility
rules.guidance: Use [*text], [^text], (^text), mechanical [ ], and [??]/[???] — never bare [] or four+ question marks.

rules.title: Empty transcription
rules.guidance: Never return an empty string; always emit at least a folio marker and column block when a page is visible.

rules.title: Catchword/signature near folio top
rules.guidance: Do not place {CW.} or {SG.} in the first few lines after [fol. …]. Put catchwords/signatures at the foot of the leaf.

rules.title: Nested braces in running header
rules.guidance: Running headers {HD.} / {HD1.} / {HD2.} must contain flat text only — no nested structural braces.

rules.title: Multiple spaces after drop cap
rules.guidance: Use exactly one space after {INn.}; extra spaces disturb facsimile gutter metrics.

rules.title: Malformed [*text] reconstruction
rules.guidance: Editorial reconstructions must be exactly [*text] with no stray asterisks inside other brackets.

rules.title: Bare empty brackets
rules.guidance: Mechanical lacunae are [ ] (interior space), never bare [].

rules.title: Folio inside open environment
rules.guidance: Close all open brace environments before emitting the next [fol. …] marker.

rules.title: Stacked diacritic markers
rules.guidance: Avoid nested/stacked @/'/~ diacritic clusters; prefer clear HSMS ASCII notation.

rules.title: Unparseable structural line
rules.guidance: Keep brace tags well-formed so the client structural tokenizer never fails.

rules.title: Empty column tag
rules.guidance: Never emit a same-line empty `{CBn.}` — open `{CBn.` on its own line, put text inside, close with `}`.

rules.title: Body text outside column
rules.guidance: After an empty `{CBn.}` mistake, wrap following body text in a proper multiline column envelope.

rules.title: Unclosed environments at EOF
rules.guidance: Every open {TAG. must have a matching } before the end of the page / document.

rules.title: Unclosed abbreviation expansion
rules.guidance: Close every <…> abbreviation expansion on the same physical line.

rules.title: Unclosed deletion
rules.guidance: Close every (… deletion marker on the same physical line.

rules.title: Unclosed insertion
rules.guidance: Close every [^… insertion marker on the same physical line.

rules.title: Stray closing brace
rules.guidance: Do not emit } without a matching open environment on the stack.

rules.title: Implicit continuation without +
rules.guidance: When an environment continues across lines, end the prior line with + (or close with }).
